analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a 'watch' stance for 3 consecutive days. RSI has exited oversold but is consolidating in the neutral zone, while MACD histogram continues weak convergence in negative territory. Volume is also subdued at 0.55x the 5-day average, making it difficult to establish a clear direction.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($237.26) vs SMA5/20/50 ($231.65/$242.50/$246.42) — Above SMA5, below SMA20/50, indicating weakening short-term trend and declining mid-term trend.
· Position vs SMA100 ($242.08)/SMA200 ($234.76) — Below SMA100, above SMA200, showing mixed mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (50.0%) + Current price level is historically in the middle range.

· RSI trajectory (38.6 → 46.2) — Exited oversold, entered neutral zone, weak upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.2973 → -1.3829) — Continued weak convergence, downward pressure remains.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band $242.50) — Trading around the middle band, with reduced volatility at 12.43% band width.

· Swing Resistance ($238.85) — Below 5-day high and Pivot PP ($240.50), acting as short-term resistance.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Not Higher Low, Not Lower High) — Confirms a sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.55x) — Subdued volume, low confidence in price movement.
· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation Phase) — Lack of directional bias, consider buying/selling on increased volume.
analysis.patternNote: 현재 가격은 5일 고가($238.38)와 스윙 저항선($238.85) 사이에 위치하며, 20일 저가($226.16)와 스윙 지지선($226.88) 사이의 좁은 범위에서 횡보하고 있다.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The current price is trading in a narrow range between the 5-day high ($238.38) and swing resistance ($238.85), and between the 20-day low ($226.16) and swing support ($226.88).
keyPoints: RSI가 과매도 구간을 벗어났으나 중립 구간에서 횡보하며 추가 상승 모멘텀이 약하다.
MACD 히스토그램은 음수 영역에서 약세 수렴을 지속하며 하락 압력이 잔존한다.

keyPointsEn: RSI has exited oversold but is consolidating in the neutral zone with weak upward momentum.
MACD histogram continues weak convergence in negative territory, indicating residual downward pressure.
Volume is subdued at 0.55x the 5-day average, reducing confidence in directional judgment.
analysis.riskNote: ADX가 19.1로 추세가 형성되지 않은 구간이므로, 현재의 횡보 움직임은 언제든 충격성 변동으로 이어질 수 있다.
analysis.riskNoteEn: With ADX at 19.1, indicating a lack of trend formation, the current sideways movement carries the risk of sudden volatile swings.
analysis.continuity: 3일 연속 관망 유지. 직전 기록과 동일하게 RSI 과매도 진입 후 약세 수렴이 지속되고 있으며, 금일 4.68%의 강한 반등에도 불구하고 RSI는 46.2로 중립 구간에 머물고 MACD는 약세 수렴을 이어가고 있어 방향 전환 신호는 아직 미약하다.
analysis.continuityEn: Watch stance maintained for 3 consecutive days. Similar to the previous record, RSI is exiting oversold with continued weak convergence. Despite today's strong 4.68% rebound, RSI remains at 46.2 in the neutral zone and MACD continues weak convergence, indicating weak signals for a directional change.
